CommandLine:
"C:\WINDOWS\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe" -Command "try { [Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8 } catch {}
$env:PYTHONUTF8='1'
$stamp = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('yyyyMMddTHHmmssZ')
$outDir = Join-Path (Get-Location) 'artifacts\gates\source-catalog-bg'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $outDir | Out-Null
$statusText = (& python -m company_wiki.source_catalog.cli --config config/source_catalog.yaml worker-status --worker-config config/source_catalog_worker.yaml 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim()
$statusPath = Join-Path $outDir (\"wr-0-worker-status-{0}.json\" -f $stamp)
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($statusPath, $statusText + [Environment]::NewLine, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
$rows = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'company_wiki\.source_catalog|source_catalog_worker|source_catalog_control' } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,CreationDate,ExecutablePath,CommandLine
$processText = ConvertTo-Json -InputObject @($rows) -Depth 6
$processPath = Join-Path $outDir (\"wr-0-processes-{0}.json\" -f $stamp)
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($processPath, $processText + [Environment]::NewLine, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
[pscustomobject]@{Stamp=$stamp; WorkerStatus=$statusPath; Processes=$processPath} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress"
